violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §747.2705)
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual
violation_type.typical_finding: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient based on the sufficient evidence that caregivers restrained children in care by bear hugging them.

finding_variants.text: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient based on the sufficient evidence that caregivers restrained children in care by bear hugging them.
Children in care were spanked as a form of discipline.  On at least one occasion this resulted in an injury to the child.
One of the caregivers tapped a 17 month old on the butt when she was in area she was not supposed to be in and was playing with an item she was not supposed to be playing with.
Based on the preponderance of evidence provided there was cruel punishment that occurred during operational hours.
